app_description: AI song cover system based on RVC v1/v2

ui.cover_usage:
Upload a song and choose a character to convert the lead vocal and generate a cover with separate audio tracks.

1. Download a character model or import your own.
2. Upload an MP3, WAV, or FLAC song.
3. Choose a character and select Start Cover.

Separation models are downloaded when first needed. Download progress appears in the application log.
ui.character_choice_info: The list shows version tags, character ownership, and model source. In versions, epochs means training epochs, while 40k/48k means sample rate.
ui.download_character_info: The list shows version tags, character ownership, and source repositories so you can distinguish different models for the same character.
ui.positive_pitch_info: Positive raises pitch, negative lowers it

conversion.pitch_shift_info: Positive values raise pitch; negative values lower it. Adjust for the song and the target model’s range.
conversion.f0_method_info: RMVPE extracts pitch from singing vocals.
conversion.index_rate_info: Higher values sound closer to the training voice, but may reduce clarity
conversion.filter_radius_info: Used by local compatibility inference; not used by the official RVC route.
conversion.rms_mix_rate_info: Closer to 1 uses more of the output loudness envelope
conversion.protect_info: Protects consonants and breath sounds; 0.5 means no protection

cover.fixed_dereverb_info: Dereverb model: Stereo BS-RoFormer 22.5050. Output uses floating-point WAV.
cover.cover_description: Upload a song and choose a character to convert the lead vocal and create a cover.
cover.automatic_cover_settings_info: Upload a song and choose a character to begin. Expand Manual adjustments to change the settings.
cover.index_rate_info: Controls the blend of retrieved index features. 0% disables retrieval; disabled when no index is available.
cover.speaker_id_info: Single-character models usually use 0; multi-speaker models may use another ID
cover.mix_preset_info: Sets vocal volume, accompaniment volume, and vocal reverb.
cover.rms_mix_rate_info: Controls how closely vocal volume changes follow the source. 0% disables envelope matching.
cover.backing_mix_info: Higher values make the original singer more audible; 0% adds none.
cover.karaoke_separation_info: Separates lead and backing vocals, converts only the lead, and exports accompaniment with and without backing vocals.
cover.karaoke_merge_backing: Keep original backing vocals in the cover
cover.karaoke_merge_backing_info: Uses accompaniment with backing vocals when on, and instrumental accompaniment when off. Both tracks can be downloaded separately.
cover.vc_preprocess_mode_info: Uses Stereo BS-RoFormer 22.5050 to remove vocal reverb.
cover.source_constraint_mode_info: Controls how closely the converted vocal follows the source timing and structure. Auto enables it after successful dereverberation.
cover.vc_preprocess_status_info: Shows the selected processing steps. Check model availability in Model management.
cover.vc_pipeline_mode_info: Standard cover supports harmony separation and vocal post-processing. The official RVC route uses UVR5 separation without those steps.

models.base_models_desc: Content, pitch, and separation models used for covers. Check model status to inspect local files, or download missing models.
models.voice_models_desc: Put .pth model files into assets/weights/, then refresh the model list.
models.mature_deecho_models_desc: The default is Stereo BS-RoFormer 22.5050. The UVR/ONNX DeEcho models below are optional downloads and are not used by the default cover workflow.
models.status_scope: File presence and component imports describe local checks; they do not validate an audio conversion.
models.workflow_models: Default vocals: Leap XE 90 bands. Instrumental: Leap Instrumental 62 bands. Lead/backing separation: MVSep 9205 three-model avg_wave. Dereverb: Stereo BS-RoFormer 22.5050.

settings.about_body:
**RVC AI Cover System**

- Supports RVC v1/v2 voice models
- Uses HuBERT, RMVPE, and FAISS for lead vocal conversion
- Includes vocal separation, harmony separation, and multitrack preview

[AI-RVC project](https://github.com/mason369/AI-RVC) · [RVC upstream project](https://github.com/RVC-Project/Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI)
settings.model_sources:
### 📥 Character Model Sources

These are the Hugging Face repositories used by the built-in character model list. You can also import `.pth` / `.index` / `.zip` from "Song Cover → Upload Custom Model", or place files manually under `assets/weights/characters/<character_name>/`:

**Love Live! Series**
- [trioskosmos/rvc_models](https://huggingface.co/trioskosmos/rvc_models) — μ's / Aqours / Nijigasaki / Liella! characters
- [Icchan/LoveLive](https://huggingface.co/Icchan/LoveLive) — Chika, Riko, Eli, You
- [0xMifune/LoveLive](https://huggingface.co/0xMifune/LoveLive) — Nijigasaki / Liella! / Hasunosora
- [Swordsmagus/Love-Live-RVC](https://huggingface.co/Swordsmagus/Love-Live-RVC) — Hanamaru, Setsuna, Kotori, A-RISE, and more
- [Zurakichi/RVC](https://huggingface.co/Zurakichi/RVC) — Nico, Kanata, Setsuna, Hanamaru
- [Phos252/RVCmodels](https://huggingface.co/Phos252/RVCmodels) — Shibuya Kanon
- [ChocoKat/Mari_Ohara](https://huggingface.co/ChocoKat/Mari_Ohara) — Mari Ohara
- [HarunaKasuga/YoshikoTsushima](https://huggingface.co/HarunaKasuga/YoshikoTsushima) — Yoshiko Tsushima
- [thebuddyadrian/RVC_Models](https://huggingface.co/thebuddyadrian/RVC_Models) — Kazuno sisters

**Genshin / Honkai / Zenless Zone Zero (HoYoverse)**
- [makiligon/RVC-Models](https://huggingface.co/makiligon/RVC-Models) — Furina, Ayaka, Focalors
- [kohaku12/RVC-MODELS](https://huggingface.co/kohaku12/RVC-MODELS) — Nahida, Herta, Firefly, Tingyun, Hoshimi Miyabi, and more
- [jarari/RVC-v2](https://huggingface.co/jarari/RVC-v2) — Furina (Korean), Silver Wolf (Korean)
- [mrmocciai/genshin-impact](https://huggingface.co/mrmocciai/genshin-impact) — Genshin voice models (`.pth` / `.index`)

**VOCALOID**
- [javinfamous/infamous_miku_v2](https://huggingface.co/javinfamous/infamous_miku_v2) — Hatsune Miku (1000 epochs)

**Hololive / VTuber**
- [megaaziib/my-rvc-models-collection](https://huggingface.co/megaaziib/my-rvc-models-collection) — Pekora, Sakura Miko, Subaru, Kobo, Kaela, and more
- [Kit-Lemonfoot/kitlemonfoot_rvc_models](https://huggingface.co/Kit-Lemonfoot/kitlemonfoot_rvc_models) — Hololive / Holostars / NIJISANJI characters

**THE IDOLM@STER / Uma Musume**
- [trioskosmos/rvc_models](https://huggingface.co/trioskosmos/rvc_models) — Ranko Kanzaki, Riamu Yumemi
- [makiligon/RVC-Models](https://huggingface.co/makiligon/RVC-Models) — Takane Shijou, Rice Shower

**Project SEKAI**
- [kohaku12/RVC-MODELS](https://huggingface.co/kohaku12/RVC-MODELS) — Nene Kusanagi

> 💡 After manual download, put `.pth` and `.index` files under `assets/weights/characters/<character_name>/`, then refresh the list.
